## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: May 25, 2026 - Jul 15, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Damonic_, Jul 15, 2026, 1/5: "I downloaded this app and tried it during the trial period. I canceled the subscription before I was supposed to be charged but they charged me anyway. They refuse to refund the money. Beware before you accept the trial period."
            2. _LatteGirl11_, Jul 1, 2026, 1/5: "I have been given marketed to get 30% off the annual rate and yet it’s the same as the most expensive rate advertised in the Apple App Store. Also, there are lower rates in the “In-App Purchases” section and yet I can’t access those rates. I can’t get a trial period and I can’t get a reduced rate to try to app so I guess I won’t try the app. The most expensive rate is too much to find out this is an app that doesn’t work for me. I’ve tried contacting the company multiple times instead of leaving a review but I have never received a response. Here are all the rates I see and yet the only one offered to me is the one for $54 even when I get a link to get 30% off of the annual rate. That is false advertising. In-App Purchases Tlimo Pro (1 Year) $54.00 Pro (1 Year) $48.00 Pro (1 Year) $54.00 Pro (1 Month) $12.00 Tiimo Pro (1 Month) $12.00 Pro (1 Year) $36.00 Pro (1 Month) $12.00 Pro (1 Month) $7.00 Pro (1 Year) $42.00 Pro (1 Month) $11.99"
            3. _Treeza17_, May 25, 2026, 2/5: "Talking to the app to get it to put my day in order is a bigger trial than using a normal calendar with reminders I’m not seeing any advantage so far & about to give up & cancel the subscription!! I can’t find any features that make life easier & it’s certainly not life changing like Alex Partridge is finding it. Having had a late ADHD diagnosis the last thing I need is a battle with an app that’s supposed to help me 🙄🙄🤷‍♀️"
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Feb 20, 2026 - Jul 22, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Tink8586_, Jul 22, 2026, 1/5: "So far it’s not great, I am on the free trial and there are lots of bugs. I am trying to reorder tasks in the routine and they’re stuck on the screen"
            2. _Online review name_, Jul 21, 2026, 2/5: "I bought the lifetime pro after using it for about a week and I won’t be using it. The basic functions are pretty good. It’s easy to schedule or reschedule a task and the widgets are solid. Where it falls apart is reliability which is a pretty big deal if you had ADHD. I’m skeptical that it always alerts me as intended, but I can’t say for sure. The one I can pinpoint is that the calendar integration is buggy on the best days. Several times I’ve had to delete and reinstall the app to get my calendar events to populate in Tiimo. Or I have to wait 15+ minutes for it to pick up an event. The wait wouldn’t be such a big deal if it just worked consistently, but when I’m waiting to see if it’s working at all, that’s a huge pain. There is also no way to search your tasks except for using the AI assistant which doesn’t really work. I’ve searched for past tasks by exact name to try to reschedule them and the AI assistant says they don’t exist. Then when I scroll for a few weeks, the task is there with the name I searched for. It’s probably better for people who like to use the AI assistant to manage more of the scheduling for them, but if you just want a robust ADHD scheduler, I don’t think I’d recommend this one."
            3. _Maaaattu_, Feb 20, 2026, 2/5: "The AI is very dumb and slow, also the whole app is glitchy. Would not buy the premium again"
<!--/ir-theme-->
